name: Scars
source: Tail, an overly optimistic orphan, teams up with Scar, a jaded and sharp-tongued mercenary, on her first adventure ever. But outside the orphanage walls life is harsher than she imagined...
translation: 乐观得有些过头的孤儿少女小尾，与愤世嫉俗、嘴毒心硬的佣兵刀疤结伴同行，踏上了人生中的第一次冒险。然而走出孤儿院高墙之后的世界，远比她想象中更加残酷无情…
